hero.subtitle: Discover the sea, develop leadership skills, and create lifelong memories together with us.

sailing.title: Sailing & Adventure
sailing.description: Learn to sail and explore the archipelago together with us. We use our dinghies such as the Optimist, Trissjolle, Avanti, and 606 to develop both knowledge and a sense of adventure.

community.title: Community
community.description: Together with us, you become part of a strong community where we help each other, have fun together, and build friendships that often last a lifetime. We have more than 75 years of scouting tradition in Hässelby Strand.

development.title: Development
development.description: Challenge yourself, learn new skills, and grow as a person. Together with us, you have the opportunity to earn badges, lead others, and develop at your own pace.

interest.heading: Ready to start your adventure?
interest.subHeading: Try a session with no commitment. Welcome aboard!
